docs.title: Profile
docs.text:
I am an R&D Scientist at the ICOB Imaging Core, Academia Sinica, Taiwan. My work combines imaging core facility support, confocal and fluorescence microscopy, bioimage analysis consultation, and reproducible workflow development.

I help researchers plan imaging experiments, troubleshoot acquisition, evaluate image data quality, and build practical analysis workflows with FIJI/ImageJ, napari, Imaris, Python, CLIJ, clEsperanto, and AI-assisted tools. I also teach hands-on microscopy and bioimage analysis courses using open-access materials that support independent learning and reproducible practice.

docs.title: Imaging Support and Bioimage Analysis
docs.text: I provide consultation across microscopy planning, image acquisition, analysis, visualization, and reproducible workflow development. Support can focus on a single technical issue or follow an imaging project across several stages.

docs.title: Experiment Planning and Acquisition
docs.text:
• Translate biological questions into measurable image features.
  • Plan confocal and fluorescence microscopy experiments.
  • Support immunofluorescence and fluorescence protein tagging workflows.
  • Troubleshoot acquisition and evaluate image quality before downstream analysis.
  • Consider sampling, controls, and measurement design when preparing quantitative imaging experiments.

docs.title: Quantitative Image Analysis
docs.text:
• Design FIJI/ImageJ workflows and ImageJ Macro scripts for repeated analysis tasks.
  • Build napari- and Python-based workflows for interactive or customized analysis.
  • Use Imaris for three-dimensional visualization and downstream quantification.
  • Develop AI-assisted segmentation workflows with ilastik, Cellpose, and microSAM.
  • Support segmentation, tracking, colocalization, nuclear localization, nuclear translocation, and large-volume preprocessing.

docs.title: Workflow Development and Acceleration
docs.text:
• Apply CLIJ for GPU-accelerated processing in FIJI/ImageJ.
  • Use clEsperanto for Python-based GPU image processing.
  • Prepare large microscopy volumes for segmentation, spot detection, and visualization.
  • Connect processing steps into documented workflows that can be repeated across datasets.

docs.title: Reproducibility and Handover
docs.text:
• Build scripts or macros for recurring analysis tasks.
  • Review workflow assumptions, parameters, and intermediate quality checks.
  • Document analysis steps for collaborators, trainees, publications, or open sharing.
  • Support hands-on transfer so researchers can run and troubleshoot workflows independently.

docs.title: Workflows and Tools
docs.text: These open-source repositories address specific microscopy analysis problems with FIJI/ImageJ macros, Python scripts, GPU-accelerated processing, and Imaris visualization resources. The descriptions below identify the data context, main workflow steps, software stack, and intended measurement value.

docs.title: Large-Volume Processing and Quantification
docs.text:
LLSM Batch Preprocessing

DataLarge-volume light-sheet microscopy raw image data.

WorkflowSuppress background noise, enhance nuclei signal, and smooth structural boundaries before spot detection or anatomical segmentation.

StackFIJI/ImageJ macros | GPU-accelerated processing | Imaris

ValuePrepares large datasets for more reliable downstream detection, segmentation, visualization, and quantification.

Yeast Nuclear Puncta Cell Counter

DataYeast fluorescence microscopy images containing nuclear puncta.

WorkflowAutomate puncta detection and quantitative counting in microscopy images.

StackOpen image analysis pipeline

ValueSupports repeatable measurement of nuclear puncta across image datasets.

docs.title: Dynamics and Colocalization
docs.text:
TF Nuclear Translocation Analysis

DataTime-lapse microscopy data with segmented and tracked single cells.

WorkflowRefine cell trajectories and quantify stress-induced Dot6-GFP nuclear translocation.

StackPython | FIJI/ImageJ | TrackMate-Cellpose

ValueConnects single-cell motion histories with quantitative transcription factor localization measurements.

TIRF Vesicle Colocalization Analysis

DataTime-series TIRF microscopy images of Glut10 and Rab5 vesicles.

WorkflowDetect, identify, and track colocalized vesicles across time.

StackPython

ValueSupports quantitative analysis of vesicle colocalization and dynamics near the cell membrane.

docs.title: Morphology and Visualization
docs.text:
Cell Distance Mesh Generator

DataMicroscopy-derived cell positions or regions.

WorkflowGenerate distance meshes between cells for spatial analysis and visualization.

StackFIJI/ImageJ macro

ValueMakes relative cell spacing available for quantitative visual interpretation.

Central Nuclei Muscle Analyzer

DataMuscle cross-sectional microscopy images.

WorkflowAnalyze nuclear localization and quantify centrally located nuclei in muscle fibers.

StackFIJI/ImageJ macro

ValueAutomates a repeated morphology measurement used in muscle image analysis.

ImageJ Hot LUT Palettes

DataQuantitative microscopy images visualized in Imaris.

WorkflowApply Imaris palette files based on familiar FIJI/ImageJ hot lookup tables.

StackImaris palettes

ValueProvides reusable, consistent color mapping for microscopy visualization.
